sources.entry: Downtify ⚠ - Download Spotify music with album art and metadata. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Downtify is a self-hosted web app that downloads Spotify, YouTube Music and Deezer links as tagged audio files and plays them back from a shared library.
summary.what_it_does: It resolves Spotify track, album, playlist and artist links from public embed pages without the Spotify API, matches them to YouTube Music results by duration, then uses yt-dlp, ffmpeg and mutagen to download, convert (MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG or OPUS) and embed title, artist, album, year and cover art. It supports free-text search, CSV imports from Soundiiz, TuneMyMusic and Exportify, and Playlist Monitor for scheduled downloads of new playlist tracks and artist releases. A built-in web player offers synced lyrics, and user accounts share one library with per-account likes and playlists. Output is written as M3U playlists and organized folders for media servers such as Jellyfin, Navidrome and Plex. Optional features include Soulseek via slskd, podcasts, a trash for deleted songs, and a library-only mode.
use_cases: Download Spotify playlists as tagged MP3 or FLAC files
Self-host a music library with a built-in player
Keep a family or household music library in sync
Watch artists and playlists for new releases automatically
Import playlists from Soundiiz, TuneMyMusic or Exportify
Subscribe to podcasts by RSS feed
how_to_run: Open http://localhost:8000 and sign in as admin / downtify
Change the admin password in Settings → General (or set DOWNTIFY_DISABLE_AUTH=true on a private server)
Paste a Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer link or search text and start the download
notable: No Spotify API keys, account or Premium subscription needed; metadata comes from public embed pages
Built-in web player with synced lyrics, equalizer and sleep timer
Playlist Monitor schedules downloads of new tracks and artist releases
Shared library with per-user accounts, likes and admin content hiding
Optional Soulseek (slskd) and Navidrome integration, plus M3U playlist export
caveats: YouTube often rate-limits downloads; a cookies.txt file is often needed to avoid failures
The Android app is still in development and no version has been published
Users are responsible for legal consequences; the README says unauthorized downloading of copyrighted material is not supported
